## Agentic Context for Better Engineering Workflows and Decisions


Sahil Kohli


October 30, 2026


Give engineers and AI agents the context they need for each engineering workflow. Rescale’s context layer connects relevant engineering information, while Agentic Projects let teams customize and save that context for specific workflows. Together, they make it easier to apply the right knowledge, guidance, and process details consistently across engineering tasks.


Learn more about how[Agentic Projects](https://rescale.com/release-notes/agentic-projects-for-project-knowledge-that-carries-across-sessions-and-teams/) use Rescale’s underlying context layer to customize how agents operate in engineering workflows.
